reason: All eleven adjudicated corrections now have source-pinned focused evidence, fresh C/JS coverage where production behavior changed, a green 4,714-test non-mutation suite, nine green generated-data checks, four green static checks, and a stable 11/33 development score. The slice is ready for the orchestrator to bind commitChecked to the implementation commit and schedule audit.

boundary.startingEvent: A player startup AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION or MSGTYPE configuration row is parsed, or an initialized pline/custompline/urgent-pline call emits a configured message.
boundary.endingEvent: The source-shaped list is installed, the normalized message is shown or suppressed, any STOP wait returns with the message window in C state, and the next input boundary is reached.
boundary.validInputs: ASCII POSIX ERE accepted or rejected by recorder glibc, including numeric backreferences, GNU word/space/boundary escapes, leading-] ranges, long messages through vpline's BUFSZ branch, STOP/urgent/override flags, and suppress_alert signed-long extremes.
boundary.observables: Installed ga/gp state, regex compile diagnostics and matches, previous-message state, input consumption, PRNG calls, complete 24x80 screens/attributes, and cursors.
boundary.exclusions: Non-ASCII C.UTF-8 collation and classes, autopickup runtime object filtering, interactive MSGTYPE editing and serialization, USER_SOUNDS, and custompline flags other than the admitted MSGTYPE boundary remain named stops before unported effects.

candidateListMethod.upstreamEntryPoints: options.c add_autopickup_exception/msgtype_add/msgtype_type, sys/share/posixregex.c regex_compile/regex_match as implemented by recorder glibc, pline.c vpline/custompline/urgent_pline/Norep, version.c get_feature_notice_ver, and win/tty/wintty.c tty_display_nhwindow/tty_clear_nhwindow.
candidateListMethod.dispatchTablesAndCatalogs: options.c msgtype_names, POSIX character classes and glibc ERE escape behavior, custompline flag constants, BUFSZ, and the existing direct-config statement table define the families.
candidateListMethod.reachableHelpers: The correctness audit traced each confirmed finding from parser or message input through list insertion, game installation, rule lookup, TTY wait/clear, and previous-message storage; direct glibc probes established every regex branch.
candidateListMethod.javascriptCrossCheck: Reviewers inspected the full diff and searched js/options.js, js/posixregex.js, js/tty_message.js, js/jsmain.js, js/version.js, and the focused startup tests for missing fields, raw values, unsupported flags, and absent assertions.
candidateListMethod.remainingLimits: The checklist is exhaustive for the eleven adjudicated findings. It does not claim non-ASCII locale matching or behavior beyond the named startup/message ending event.

entries.candidate: options.c add_autopickup_exception() retains compiled regex state
entries.reachability: Every accepted AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION compiles before its node is prepended and installed into game.ga.
entries.owner: js/options.js add_autopickup_exception() and js/jsmain.js NethackGame startup installation
entries.effects: The installed ga.apelist node owns pattern, grab, regex, and next.
entries.evidence: js/options.js stores the compiled object on each node and installParsedGa preserves node/regex identity. The 13-test startup autopick suite pins parsed-to-game identity and matching; the fresh 22-segment C/JS recipe passes 59,725 PRNG calls and 230 screens/cursors.
entries.remaining: None within installed startup state; runtime object filtering remains excluded.

entries.candidate: glibc numeric backreferences in POSIX ERE
entries.reachability: Valid MSGTYPE and autopickup patterns may contain captures and numeric references; orphan and forward references fail compilation.
entries.effects: Compile acceptance, exact diagnostic, and rule-match result.
entries.evidence: The direct recorder-ABI oracle passes valid one-digit references, following literal digits, branch-specific references, same-start alternatives, and nonparticipating optional groups, while orphan, forward, and self references preserve Invalid back reference. The complete direct oracle passes 36 regex comparisons and the 18-test MSGTYPE suite plus fresh live MSGTYPE/autopick recipes are green.
entries.remaining: None for ASCII recorder-glibc numeric-reference cases at this boundary.

entries.candidate: glibc word, space, and boundary escape operators
entries.reachability: ASCII patterns may use \b, \B, \<, \>, \w, \W, \s, or \S; zero-width boundaries cannot be repeated.
entries.effects: Compile acceptance and MSGTYPE action selection.
entries.evidence: The 18-test MSGTYPE suite pins matches for all eight GNU operators and all four boundary operators with *, +, ?, and {1}; the direct libc oracle confirms exact matches and Invalid preceding regular expression diagnostics, and fresh live MSGTYPE/autopick cases pass.
entries.remaining: None for ASCII word, space, or boundary operators.

entries.candidate: leading literal ] as a bracket-range endpoint
entries.reachability: A bracket expression whose first literal is ] may immediately form a range.
entries.evidence: Validation and translation now route the leading ] through bracketItem. Focused membership tests, fresh live MSGTYPE/autopick cases, and the direct libc oracle confirm ^[]-a]$ and exact Invalid range end for []--].

entries.candidate: pline.c vpline() BUFSZ message normalization before every consumer
entries.reachability: Formatted byte strings of 256 through 511 bytes enter vpline's modest-overflow arm before MSGTYPE lookup.
entries.effects: Bytes 249-251 become ..., the original final three bytes are preserved, and matching/rendering/history use the same 255-byte value.
entries.evidence: normalizeVplineMessage performs the pline.c modest-overflow rewrite once before lookup, rendering, norep comparison, and history. Focused tests distinguish a removed middle pattern from the retained final XYZ bytes; three fresh direct C/JS cases at 256, 300, and 511 bytes pass.

entries.candidate: MSGTYP_STOP explicit display_nhwindow wait and clear
entries.reachability: A matching STOP rule renders a one-line or wrapped message after window initialization.
entries.effects: One wait, updated previous-message state, and post-return row/cursor matching tty_clear_nhwindow().
entries.evidence: displayPendingTtyMessageWindow ports the explicit more()/restore-NEED_MORE/tty_clear_nhwindow sequence. Focused short, pending, and wrapped cases pin one exact wait plus post-return row/cursor state; the fresh 17-segment MSGTYPE recipe passes 46,608 PRNG calls and 70 screens/cursors.
entries.remaining: None for one-line, pending-topline, or wrapped STOP at this boundary.

entries.candidate: urgent messages still honor MSGTYP_STOP lookup
entries.reachability: URGENT_MESSAGE bypasses only NOSHOW/NOREP suppression; STOP remains active.
entries.effects: One STOP wait and previous-message update.
entries.evidence: The focused urgent-STOP case queues a space and sentinel key, observes exactly one wait, proves the sentinel remains, confirms history, and checks the cleared physical row after return.
entries.remaining: None for urgent STOP lookup and wait behavior.

entries.reachability: custompline with OVERRIDE_MSGTYPE leaves msgtyp normal even when a STOP pattern matches.
entries.owner: scripts/startup-msgtype.test.mjs over js/tty_message.js override entry point
entries.effects: No wait and no input consumption; rendered pending message updates history.
entries.evidence: The focused override-STOP case queues a sentinel key, observes zero waits and no input consumption, and pins pending output and previous-message state.
entries.remaining: None for the admitted exact OVERRIDE_MSGTYPE operation.

entries.candidate: version.c atoi signed-long saturation before int narrowing
entries.reachability: suppress_alert components can exceed LONG_MAX or LONG_MIN within the byte-bounded config value.
entries.evidence: The 11-test suppress_alert suite directly pins positive overflow to 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFF00n and negative underflow to 0n through get_feature_notice_ver().
entries.remaining: None for signed-long saturation before packed-version narrowing.

entries.reachability: Any valid ASCII regex may use one of the twelve C.UTF-8 ASCII class names.
entries.effects: Positive and negative membership for every mapping.
entries.evidence: The focused table independently pins positive and negative ASCII membership for alnum, alpha, blank, cntrl, digit, graph, lower, print, punct (including [), space, upper, and xdigit; the broad non-mutation suite includes all assertions.
entries.remaining: None for the twelve ASCII class mappings.

entries.candidate: custompline flag surface stops unsupported bits explicitly
entries.reachability: The exported MSGTYPE override helper can receive SUPPRESS_HISTORY, NO_CURS_ON_U, or other unimplemented bits.
entries.effects: Supported override works; every unsupported bit reaches a named boundary before output/state/input changes.
entries.evidence: ttyCustomPline admits only exact OVERRIDE_MSGTYPE and throws UnsupportedCustomPlineFlagsError before effects for zero, each known unsupported flag, a mixed flag set, and an unknown bit. Focused tests pin unchanged output/history and an unconsumed sentinel key.
entries.remaining: None for the narrowed API; every other custompline flag remains an explicit before-effect boundary.

sourceReview: Implementation re-read options.c add_autopickup_exception, sys/share/posixregex.c plus fresh C.UTF-8 glibc probes, pline.c vpline/custompline/urgent_pline, version.c get_feature_notice_ver, and wintty.c tty_display_nhwindow/tty_clear_nhwindow. The completed evidence covers all eleven adjudicated candidates, installed identity, exact diagnostics and matches, one-owner message normalization, waits and clears, input boundaries, screens/cursors, and zero new PRNG effects. Non-ASCII locale behavior and the other exclusions remain named boundaries.
